sharedRules.status: INHERITED with these seven's explicit target choices
sharedRules.rule: Use complete actual source classAccess for rank/minimum/school/baseRP. All seven are Action,60ft,V/S/F. Base costs Clone/Rebind/Sculptor13; Reversal/Theft7; Seal/Communion10. Real Action, RP, body/hand/focus, repertoire and predeclared fixed choices precede casting. Starting incompatible concentration ends it at commitment; none of these seven itself requires concentration except ordinary Ready's paid hold. Counter windows are at casting/preparation only. Actual class reductions, base strain, Refrain and surcharge are retained; no refund for a legal paid failure. Ordinary Ready fixes spell/mode/inverse/type/IDs then selects legal actual target/effect/area at release under its exact contract. No reaction/extra Action provider is invented.

Real regular START/END identities are distinct from numbered rounds and absolute seconds. Future markers exclude already underway phases where specified. No extra turn, absence, replacement or suppression resets an original marker. Refresh real action wallets only at actual applicable START; same-round owner-wide companion/copy/extra-action history remains. Outside-initiative local deadlines stay fixed on later initiative entry. Expiry/true source end precedes later same-time payload requests. Registered fallback clocks explicitly identified in Rebind supply no turns.

Source and target witnesses belong to real declared bodies/anchors. Distances are actual occupied-boundary separation unless a named source supplies center/emitter convention. A range witness and line-of-effect segment must be consistent. Complete body fit, intervening occupied space, visibility and actual supports are separate predicates. Synthetic fixture geometry is explicitly stated, not a new creature or campaign route. Images are nonphysical: no body/collision/cover/load.

Retain original cast, application, component, creator, dealer and source budgets. A modifier's creator does not inherit an ordinary parent's attacks/healing/kills. New healing-to-damage roots use the actual native producer at the declared checkpoint; original damage transformations retain lineage. No duplicate callbacks reapply effect, pay/refresh twice, or renew inversion/transfer/one-shot entitlements. Explicit new local exceptions never import a generic copying/conversion system.

Complete accepted Antimagic/GreaterDispel input/output, immutable captured operations and self-field exception govern. Distinguish a current suppressed expression from true source ending. Clocks and spent history continue; no missed command or pulse is banked. Temporary suppression never reverses completed HP, movement or costs. Parent-specific body suppression/ending always controls, and a modifier's resumption never recreates an ended parent.

Perception/access precede declared selection; no silent source owner/rank/hostility roster is published. Private draws, application IDs and known-false records are durable internal data, not a sixth Fate channel. Each event's observations are immutable copies of its own after-state. Native and historical source text remain separately complete. Case premises about actors, actual acquired class choices, knowledge, consent, space and provider events are synthetic source-qualified inputs, never proof of campaign acquisition or runtime behavior.

reviewFlags: Core resolution requires an explicit operational interpretation

spells.procedure:
KEEP exactly one illusionary copy of the caster lasting3rounds. NEW place one visual/audible image matching the caster's actual visible body/equipment at a perceived legal open position within60feet/line of effect. It is a nonphysical image in the caster's current size/appearance snapshot,not a creature/object withHP. The copied appearance does not update when the caster later transforms or changes clothes;creating a replacement pays a new cast. It produces ordinary conversational speech/simple body sounds in the caster's known voice/languages,not light,heat,smell,force,real music powers or a new sensory feed. NEW no concentration;ends at the caster's third future regular START or18elapsed seconds outside initiative,preserving the original marker/deadline through extra turns and absence.

Once on each actual ordinary caster turn,an available Bonus Action can move the image up to30feet through a declared continuous path within60feet/caster line of effect and direct one brief mundane performance or sentence. It cannot pass through walls,closed doors or another solid barrier;it may visually imitate an actual apparent locomotion the snapshot body has,but that creates no cargo/support/anatomy permission. It can overlap real creatures because it lacks substance,without blocking them. The Bonus Action uses the real action wallet;the image gets no independent turn or attack. With no command it holds its last position/pose and continues only a previously declared simple idle appearance,not independent plans,choices or secret observations. Losing command range leaves it stationary until expiry,not invisibly following the caster.

NEW decoy function:while this image is within5feet of its actual caster and both are legal visible candidate positions for an incoming direct attack roll,a sight-dependent attacker who has not identified this image as false cannot visually distinguish them during the spell's brief identical-image shimmer. Select uniformly among the caster and this live indistinguishable image before rolling. If actual Mirror Image duplicates also legally qualify,use one combined uniform selection among the caster and all eligible live visual duplicates,not serial independent miss chances. No image outside the attack's real reach/range/line of effect joins that selection. A source explicitly ignoring visual illusions,actual True Seeing,or that attacker's genuine recognition removes the corresponding false candidate.

If the true caster is selected,resolve that one attack normally. If Arcane Clone is selected,roll against the caster's current realAC;hit ends this clone,miss leaves it. No numericHP damage,critical body injury,on-hit resource,corpse or actual creature-target rider is generated. The attack's ordinary ammunition/action costs stay spent. At a separate position outside the decoy pairing,the image can be deliberately mistaken for an apparent creature and attacked using this same image-hit procedure,but it never automatically intercepts an attack on the caster. Caster/allies cannot intentionally farm hits/procs from their known false image. Area/save effects ignore it;it grants no cover,flanking or reaction interception. Choosing among overlapping valid visual duplicates occurs only once for the original attack lineage.

An observer may spend an Action on INT(Investigation)against the original spellDC to recognize the image;real direct physical passage/touch showing no substance establishes recognition without a roll for that observer. Identification leaves its appearance for others but removes its own mechanical deception against that observer. True Seeing uses its actual source scope. A known false image cannot block that observer's sight,though unrelated actual terrain still can. An imitated casting gesture is no real spell commitment and creates no Counterspell trigger,RP payment,spell copy or new attack. A genuine readied response to an actually observed movement/sound can still use its real trigger rules;the image does not force anyone to respond.

One Arcane Clone per caster;successful new creation replaces the old,without returning resources or resetting an attack already begun. Suppression hides the image and removes its decoy candidacy while the original deadline continues;missed commands do not queue,and return supplies no new duplicate or forgotten-disbelief reset. Actual dispel,expiry,a qualifying hit or caster death ends it. This is neither a biological clone,extra class sheet,stored consciousness,death replacement nor soul transfer.

MM127-CLONE-01 — NEW exact targeting completion. The combined draw is a private uniformly sampled list of actual eligible candidates: real caster first, original Mirror Image duplicate IDs in stable original order, then this Clone. Filter perception, reach/range and line of effect BEFORE the one draw. If no Clone qualifies, Mirror Image's own complete contract still governs; this completion changes neither its concentration nor native three-duplicate count. Recognition disqualifies only the observer's known-false candidates. No sixth Fate presentation or public candidate roster is emitted.
A direct attack roll whose original selected target is the real caster may use this narrow redirect, including a sight-dependent spell attack which legally selected that real creature. A separate apparent Clone may be selected only by an ordinary weapon/unarmed Attack Action's apparent-target permission selected HERE. This does not make it a creature or extend to creature-only spells, named class techniques, opportunity attacks or other creature-bound selectors. No Spectral Army paid-hidden-target bridge is inherited. A known-false image is ineligible for deliberate productive attacks. An image miss/hit consumes the original action/ammunition/attack slot but generates no creature hit, critical injury or downstream healing/resource event.
The Clone's Bonus Action command uses the real actor's one BA, not a companion command. An owner cannot command a pet and this image with the same single BA. No companion offense budget is spent or created by the image. Existing Mirror Image concentration is compatible with nonconcentrating Clone; countering a new Clone never replaces either current source. Image loss does not refund a completed original attack.

spells.procedure:
Action; range 60 feet; V/S/F. KEEP reversal of an ongoing magical effect, including the source’s Heal-to-Harm example. NEW select one individually perceived live target-local numerical component of an actual ordinary spell of generating rank at most four, with line of effect to its real recipient/anchor. Name exactly one admissible inverse from this finite table: (1) a future normal-HP healing output becomes necrotic damage of the same computed amount; (2) a future direct damage output becomes normal-HP healing of the same computed amount; (3) a flat AC, attack-roll, ability-check or saving-throw modifier changes sign with the same magnitude; (4) one typed resistance becomes vulnerability to that same type, or vice versa; (5) a stated double-Speed multiplier becomes half-Speed, or a half-Speed multiplier becomes double-Speed, using the actual native Speed arbitration. One selected component, including its linked repeated future opportunities, is modified; other parent components remain themselves. No inverse is supplied for immunity, hard control, conditions, transformation, Invisible/sensory information, temporary/form HP, HP maxima, RP/charges/items, physical work, creature creation, damage transfer, a portal or a completed instantaneous result. An actual spell-created companion’s heal/attack is eligible only if it is an explicitly defined output component of the ongoing spell parent with all its original command/offense budgets, rather than an independent creature feature inferred from a name. Make one casting-ability plus PB task check against DC 10 + twice the actual generating rank, Core degrees/natural shifts collapsed to success/failure. Success installs the chosen inversion; failure changes nothing. Unknown rank/component ineligibility can defeat a paid attempt without disclosing hidden facts. NEW reversal requires no concentration of its own and lasts only until the parent/component ends or sixty seconds from reversal, whichever is earlier. Original owner, statistics, concentration, targets, costs, eligibility, schedule, reserves and already spent opportunities remain. It does not reset a tick, create a new recipient or revive ended concentration. A specific parent/component may be successfully inverted only once in its lifetime across all casters; the consumed inversion flag survives suppression/removal, and the inversion cannot itself be selected for recursive inversion. Qualifying removal of the reversal restores only the surviving parent’s original future behavior, never past results or consumed opportunities. For output conversion, retain the original legal trigger/attack/save and source-funded amount. Compute the numerical amount through its source’s ordinary formula, actual limit and relevant source funding, before the original recipient’s healing-specific or damage-specific mitigation. An HP-healing reserve that would be debited only for actual restoration instead commits no more than this converted amount from its remaining reserve once; it cannot emit free damage while keeping that budget. Apply the final category’s actual target rules and defenses once: converted damage uses necrotic immunity/resistance/prevention/buffers and can cause ordinary Wounds/concentration; converted healing uses living-recipient eligibility, actual healing restrictions and maximum-HP cap, with no resurrection or excess reserve. No healing-only bonus/prohibition is copied into necrotic defenses, and no damage resistance is applied a second time to converted healing. Any source-specific fraction/funding explicitly based on an earlier real damage event still needs that genuinely qualifying earlier event; conversion cannot fund itself, create reciprocal drain healing, or use reflected/copied output as a fresh source occurrence. An attack-origin converted heal does not become two events or a free second attack; original hit/secondary riders retain only their expressly independent scope, while damage-dependent riders see no damage from the converted component. A save that originally halves the eligible source output retains that half before final-category processing; a success preventing the original output supplies nothing to convert. Resolve signed numeric and resistance/Speed changes through their actual stat rules, preserving separate source records; multiple reversals cannot add duplicate magnitude. The Healing tag grants no new heal and the Heal-to-Harm example never undoes HP already restored.

MM127-REVERSAL-01 — NEW Water Pet exception and category boundary. The exact AC4 Water Pet parent explicitly permits its 2d6 heal or cold attack in the same original-owner/numbered-round offensive/support slot. This Reversal deliberately authorizes conversion of that native heal despite the parent's ordinary no-conversion restriction; no other generic source exception follows. Its original owner's real Bonus Action command, true attached phase, pet Action, willing eligible ally at5ft/line of effect, ordinary parent concentration and deadline all remain. There is no healing reserve. The native 2d6 computed potential is not limited to target missing HP before conversion; final category handles HP cap/defenses. Original living-ally eligibility and actual informed willingness remain requirements, including knowledge that the present command will deliver harm. A heal prohibition alone does not prohibit necrotic damage; it is never consumed as a next-heal reducer by the converted damage. No owner personal cast/heal trigger or free command occurs.
For an original healing-only opportunity converted to damage, create the damage root after the native action/trigger legality and source funding checks and before mitigation. Dealer is the actor actually producing the native healing: Water Pet here, NOT the inverter or its controller. Snapshot that dealer's actually qualifying Null state then; do not invent one. For an already damage-rooted component converted to healing, retain original lineage/Null history but emit no damage event, Wound, damage resource or damage-dependent secondary rider. Independent native costs and recipient riders remain where their own text still applies. No simultaneous normal heal accompanies converted damage.
MM127-REVERSAL-02 — Component identity and lifetime. Attach to one permanent parent-component key and, when the source is recipient-local, its one real application key. A native pet healing action that selects willing allies on later commands is one action component, not an invented permanent single-target roster; later legal targets are native command selections. Mark the successful inversion before callbacks. The mark survives dispelling/suppression of this modifier. Inversion of this modifier itself is illegal. An eligible otherwise lawful removal may end this rank4 modifier alone; it does not end the surviving original parent. Temporary suppression only suspends future conversion and never banks an opportunity.
The synthetic eight-unit reserve obligation remains conditional on an independently authorized spell reserve. For such a genuinely supplied source, commit the converted potential from that actual reserve once, capped by its available units; no reserve is granted to Water Pet. Actual ongoing modifier records traveling with a Spell-Theft-eligible original bundle retain these identities and clocks.

Success: half the one5d10packet,rounded down,and no defense suppression. Failure: first establish the selected-type suppression below, then resolve the full5d10packet through remaining real defenses. No spell attack, vulnerability, RP drain or damage-type conversion is added.

NEW failed-save suppression lasts until the target's first future regular END,excluding an in-progress target turn,or6elapsed seconds outside initiative. No concentration; the initial damage remains instantaneous while this separate rider is ongoing. During its operative interval, suppress all actual resistance and immunity to the chosen damage type on that recipient, including simultaneously present sources and later gained sources. Suppress neither unrelated types nor flat reduction,temporaryHP,survival replacement,absolute invulnerability against an independently defined category,or a source's other benefits. Keep the original defense records,owners,eligibility and deadlines. This is an overlay,not permanent deletion or a change in creature type. If Rebind is suppressed,covered defenses can operate during that gap; if the still-live rider resumes,they become suppressed again without a new save,damage packet or fresh endpoint. An immunity that independently expires or is removed during the interval does not reappear when Rebind ends. The initial packet still uses ordinary damage ownership,transfer,concentration,Wounds and death resolution once. A transfer into another creature meets that recipient's actual defenses; Rebind follows the original recipient,not the packet into every other body. On expiry or actual eligible removal,only still-existing eligible defenses return. Dispel cannot undo the earlier damage. No repeated damage tick,hard-control claim,automatic critical,permanent elemental rewrite or free healing appears.

MM127-REBIND-01 — Type coverage, not defense-source deletion. A resistance/immunity whose actual predicate covers the selected type, including the selected portion of an all-damage resistance, is covered while that predicate is otherwise true. An immunity explicitly against source disablement, an independent absolute prevention, Null nonlethal handling, flat reductions, body lifecycle and transfer are not retyped as elemental resistance. No assumed material composition, pet-name immunity or class immunity is granted.
For a recipient with no ordinary independent regular turn, register the actual recognized owner-attached phase END as its next-future eligible END, excluding a phase already underway. If no phase actually exists, select a source-only recorded END every six elapsed seconds from that recipient application's establishment, with first fallback at+6; this NEW rider-save-free expiration clock grants no Actions, saves or extra turn. A transition to a genuinely supplied phase cannot postpone an already earlier endpoint. The original ending always wins before later callbacks. Original independent defense-source expiries remain processed while suppressed.
MM129 native defense completion: the actual supplied Protection from Energy grants chosen fire immunity for its caster tenth future START (or 60 elapsed seconds outside initiative), Wizard Arcane Ward supplies independently acquired fire resistance, and an adjacent Warrior11 Wardborn with acquired Protective Mutations and an actually active equipped mutation supplies first-damage-per-numbered-round flat DR3 to an ally other than self. The full compatible paid fixtures are TU6-01-A and TU6-01-B. These provider prerequisites are now supplied; their positive cases are no longer missing-content holds. No other defense is inferred.

spells.procedure:
KEEP reshaping area spells to exclude allies. NEW Action gives one willing perceived caster within60feet/line of effect,including self,one Sculptor preparation for60elapsed seconds without concentration. This expressly replaces Instantaneous metadata with a finite preparation followed by one parent-bound exclusion. There is one unspent preparation per recipient across casters;successful replacement ends the old unspent one. The recipient must initiate their next genuinely acquired eligible area spell before this deadline and pay that spell's own actual costs/components/action/cadence. Sculptor pays only its own13RP and supplies no cast,extra Action,spell access or new damage.

Eligible parent:one actual personally initiated rank0through6spell with an area that directly applies damage,healing,conditions or other creature effects to occupants. The real generating rank,not a wrapper's cheaper cost,controls. A source that only creates bodies,objects,solid walls,permanent matter or changed terrain is not an eligible creature-area payload merely because it has dimensions. A genuine area spell with mixed direct and physical clauses can be selected,but exclusion changes only the direct creature-facing clauses below. Copy/echo events that are not actual new casts cannot spend this preparation as another cast. A fully acquired actual Matrix/item source counts only when it genuinely performs an eligible spell cast under its own complete rules.

At that parent's commitment,before counters or hidden outcomes,the recipient designates any number of distinct actually perceived allied creatures within60feet of the recipient and its line of effect,including self. They need not yet be in the parent's area. Fix this exclusion roster before paying/resolving the parent. At least one valid designated ally is required to spend the preparation;an otherwise legal spell with no such roster leaves Sculptor pending. On legal parent commitment,consume the preparation immediately;countering or failure later gives no refund or free second parent. The Sculptor caster does not choose the recipient's spell/roster or become its damage owner.

For the parent's initial resolution and up to60elapsed seconds thereafter while that same parent remains,omit all its direct creature-facing applications to each still-existing, eligible designated creature that is still an actual ally of the parent caster at that event. No save,damage,healing,condition,buff,debuff or direct source trigger applies to that excluded recipient from that parent occurrence. The exclusion is not merely success on its save and does not generate an avoided-damage/save-success/resource event. It also prevents the parent's directly coupled worn/carried-item payload where that payload is part of affecting the excluded creature;it does not protect separately targeted objects or remote possessions. Already resolved damage/conditions from an earlier spell cannot be undone by later Sculptor.

Keep the parent's actual center,shape,area,range,concentration,targets,damage dice,ownership and source lifetime. No area expansion,extra creature count,hard cover or general magical immunity is created. For an ongoing zone,moving/entering/leaving and its actual event caps continue;selected allies are omitted at their actual covered application events. Leaving and reentering does not add a new60seconds. A selected creature that genuinely ceases to be an ally loses exclusion while that is true;returning actual alliance can restore only the same remaining original exclusion. Newly allied or previously undesignated creatures do not join. These private predicates supply no automatic faction/alignment report.

An actual physical wall,stone,ice,water,fire fuel,collapse or other world consequence created by a mixed spell remains real for everyone. Sculptor supplies no passage through solid matter,air to breathe,visibility through environmental fog or exemption from an independently caused fall. A direct magical Speed penalty/condition from the selected parent is excluded;ordinary terrain/obscurity as a physical world fact is not silently removed. This is the explicit proposed meaning of reshaping around allied recipients rather than geometrically creating reusable holes in every effect. Mixed-source cases require the parent's real clauses to distinguish direct payload from independent physical consequences.

The consumed preparation's exclusion persists as one rank-six modifier application attached to that exact parent,ending when the parent ends,its own60seconds expire or the modifier is actually removed. Its caster's concentration is not required;the parent's real concentration remains entirely its original caster's. Eligible suppression of Sculptor disables only this exclusion for the actual gap and preserves both clocks;resumption does not erase effects legitimately suffered during the gap. Dispelling the modifier does not dispel the parent unless a real dependency says so,and ending the parent cannot restore the consumed preparation. A later Sculptor preparation can fund a different later actual cast,but two preparations never create stacked exclusion on the same parent or extend its original clock.

MM127-SCULPT-01 — NEW active-creature scope. A still-existing actual Undead/Construct/summoned creature can be an allied roster identity; biological living is not required by Sculptor. Its parent still has its own recipient rules. Dead remains, an ended body or a newly created replacement do not inherit the old identity. Actual perceived allies are frozen at the parent's commitment. With ordinary Ready the eligible parent is cast at PREPARATION: spend the Sculptor preparation and fix roster then. Release chooses the actual parent area/target under ordinary Ready but cannot choose new exclusion identities. Modifier's60-second active-application maximum starts at the parent's successful manifestation; any earlier consumed preparation deadline is not a second casting expiry. The real held spell can expire/counter/lose concentration before manifestation, wasting the consumed preparation.
Mixed parent payload is adjudicated by complete current text, not words such as physical or ice. Accepted Ice Storm's direct magical bludgeoning and cold are both omitted, while its actual environmental difficult-terrain footprint remains and doubles real grounded movement cost. No slip/Prone/object injury is invented. Omission generates no successful save or avoided-damage resource.
Actual Lesser Antimagic suppresses parent and modifier at the affected locus. It is NOT a source for selective suppression of only Sculptor while the same magical parent payload remains active. Likewise actual Greater Dispel snapshots all eligible co-located termination operations before any ending and never rescans. The original selective-suppression positive remains conditional on a separately supplied selective source. The modifier's rank6 removability alone does not create that missing mechanism.

spells.procedure:
KEEP Action,60feet,one magical effect locked in place so it CANNOT BE DISPELLED. NEW in place means protecting the continuing magical application,not spatial immobilization or permanent duration. Select one individually perceptible existing ongoing magical effect with an actual independent application/source identity and a genuine dispel interface,with a reachable actual recipient/anchor/effect portion within60feet and caster line of effect. No rank cap,save or owner consent is added; this can protect another source's beneficial or harmful effect,but cannot force that source to remain. A class engine/whole creature identity,completed instantaneous consequence,mundane matter or unselectable vague aura is not an eligible one-effect target. Actual source protections against targeting still apply. On successful resolution,NEW establish one nonconcentration Seal for up to24elapsed hours,ending earlier when the protected application ends. This explicitly supplies the missing lifetime rather than treating Instantaneous as frozen forever. While the Seal operates,ordinary dispelling cannot end the protected effect OR this protective Seal itself,including Greater Dispel and lower eligible dispels. The Seal cannot be trivially dispelled first to nullify the printed strong clause. A source explicitly overriding nondispellable protection retains only its real scope; no such bypass is invented here. Counterspell can stop the Seal during its own cast window,before protection exists; Seal does not retroactively protect a spell that has not yet resolved. Suppression is separate and can disable this Seal/protected effect where genuinely applicable without pausing either clock. While the Seal itself is suppressed its no-dispel benefit is unavailable; another actual dispel must still be independently able to resolve through any suppression/barriers and satisfy the protected effect's normal eligibility. This grants no casting inside antimagic exception. The protected effect keeps original owner,rank,DC,concentration,spatial motion,shape changes,charges,pulses,resource history,expiry,voluntary dismissal,dependent-body destruction and every non-dispel ending. No part is frozen or refilled; a minute effect still ends after its own minute even though the Seal could otherwise last a day. Target-local multi-recipient applications are separate: seal only the selected recipient application and its inseparable dependent components,not every remote recipient or original casting character. A genuinely indivisible field/wall can be one whole selected effect if a reachable portion is eligible. A spell-specific independent effect is not promoted into a larger parent to protect an entire catalog/class. MM127-SEAL-01 — NEW reciprocal local exclusion: Spell Seal cannot select Spell Seal, Resonance Seal or Resonance Anchor themselves. The three complete existing procedures stay distinct. Resonance Seal's existing exclusions are inherited; Resonance Anchor's text is NOT rewritten or made nondispellable. Spell Seal has no independent movable spatial origin to invent for an otherwise excluded Anchor target; an attached modifier does not anchor its living carrier. Its own nondispel protection is intrinsic. Multiple valid Seals may protect the same original application,with no cumulative duration addition or charge pooling; each keeps its own paid24-hour endpoint and benefit operates while at least one unsuppressed Seal remains. A new Seal cannot attach to an ended application,resurrect a replaced source,prevent a permitted controller dismissal or transfer source ownership. Ending a Seal does not itself end the otherwise still-live protected spell.

MM127-SEAL-02 — Snapshot removal. An ordinary dispel neither rolls to defeat this active protection nor treats it as automatic rank0. Only the actual unsuppressed protection predicate at the captured operation can exclude that operation. The accepted Lesser Antimagic self-field termination exception reaches its own field operation, not the co-suppressed Seal/parent. Ending that field in Greater Dispel does not rescan or revive suppressed operations. A successful field removal can resume an otherwise live protection before any later cast; it is not a proved Seal bypass. A source-qualified future selective suppressor/remover remains conditional.
The Seal is attached to the chosen actual application, not ownership. If an otherwise legally transferable buff is stolen, that SAME bundle carries a Seal and its original expiry with it; the Seal's creator is unchanged and it never prevents the true parent owner ending concentration or Haste ending costs. A completed image-hit, native expiry, failed maintenance or true source-dependent destruction still wins.
